question: Which chapter concludes in the text emerged from Candradvīpa?
premises: A text or section is said to have emerged from Candradvīpa.
The chapter is identified as the seventh.
inference: The seventh chapter in the work emerged from Candradvīpa is concluded.
uncertainties: The form paṭamaḥ may be a variant spelling for paṭalaḥ (chapter).
plain_english: In the work emerged from Candradvīpa, this is the seventh chapter.
